title: A Comparison of Approaches to Advertising Measurement: Evidence from Big Field Experiments at Facebook
authors: Brett R. Gordon; Florian Zettelmeyer; Neha Bhargava; Dan Chapsky
eligible_reason: Compares RCT lift estimates from Facebook ad experiments with observational estimators (exact/CEM matching, PSM, stratification, regression adjustment, IPWRA, stratified regression) on user-level cross sections. No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: main.do runs simulate_data.do, stratify_imbens.do and analyze_cem/strat/psm/reg/ipwra/stratreg.do; e.g. reg converted exposed covariates if is_test==1; CEM-weighted regression.
data_files_note: readme.txt: Facebook data proprietary; simulate_data.do generates a 2-million-user simulated study.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
